scope: Integrity and coverage/advisory behavior in temporary copies; original model evidence unchanged

checks.name: Saved evidence verifies without an AI acceptance score
Reviewer wording preference does not block verification
A subjective note cannot silently become a hard gate
Missing optional teaching remains an observation, not a case failure
A claimed exercised target still needs actual source evidence
No reusable items is not a correctness failure
Valid teaching on a short response is not labelled filler and rejected
Fixed-case identity remains a hard check
